note: Single source of truth for the Gjöll data pipeline. The diagram in figures/pipeline.svg is drawn from this file by scripts/build_pipeline_diagram.py, and www.gjoll.is renders its pipeline page from this file too. Every number under `figures` is recomputed from the deposited CSVs by `build_pipeline_diagram.py --check`, which runs in CI, so the page, the diagram and the data cannot disagree.

source.en: Newspaper archives (Tímarit.is), yearbooks, investigation reports, court records

what.en: Every fatal fire incident 1968–2025 is recorded with its documentary sources, verified against at least two independent sources where available. The registry was finalized on 31 December 2025.
what.is: Hvert banvænt brunatilvik 1968–2025 er skráð með heimildum sínum og staðfest með minnst tveimur óháðum heimildum þar sem þær eru til. Gagnasafninu var lokað 31. desember 2025.

gate.en: Deposited at DATICE and published at gjoll.is
gate.is: Varðveitt hjá GAGNÍS og birt á gjoll.is

what.en: Two language models (Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.5) apply the predefined classification rule to each fire-mechanism description without seeing the construction year. Their codings are frozen and deposited.
what.is: Tvö mállíkön (Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.5) beita fyrirfram skilgreindri flokkunarreglu á lýsingu hvers bruna án þess að sjá byggingarárið. Kóðun þeirra er fryst og varðveitt.

tool.en: Two language models, as a reproducibility check only

gate.en: Agreement and Cohen's κ recomputed offline from the frozen table
gate.is: Samræmi og κ Cohens endurreiknuð án nettengingar úr frystu töflunni

title.is: Heimtur bornar saman við opinberar tölur

source.en: Statistics Iceland cause-of-death series, ICD-10 X00–X09

what.en: Annual registry death counts are reconciled year by year against the official cause-of-death series, which requires no individual-level linkage.
what.is: Árlegur fjöldi látinna í skránni er stemmdur af, ár fyrir ár, við opinberu dánarmeinaskrána án tengingar á einstaklingsstigi.

source.en: Statistics Iceland population (MAN00000) and completed dwellings (IDN03001)
source.is: Mannfjöldi (MAN00000) og fullgerðar íbúðir (IDN03001) frá Hagstofu Íslands

what.en: Rates per million, construction-period cohort rates per person-year, and an interrupted time-series model, all computed from the deposited tables.
what.is: Tíðni á milljón íbúa, tíðni eftir byggingartímabili á mannár og rofin tímaraðagreining, allt reiknað úr varðveittu töflunum.

gate.en: Every reported statistic recomputed in CI on every push
gate.is: Hver birt tala endurreiknuð í CI við hverja breytingu
